canonical_note5.text:
The original task remains unchanged: all retained actual big rational bundles on all retained smooth integral projective X over every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, with no cardinality, support, skeleton, finite-generation or toric restriction. The intended positive mass is raw V=vol_X(L)>0. The genuine cone and minimal reference R=P_theta(0) are the scalar objects proved in n1. The intended entire energy is E(u)=inf_{f continuous, f>=u} mathscr E(f), E1={genuine u:E(u)>-infinity}. Its requisite whole theory is not constructed here. Targets would have raw mass V, miss reference poles, integrate every actual relative R-u, and have finite intrinsic dual supremum sup_{u(v0)=0}[E(u)+integral(R-u)dnu]. No replacement by a smaller test class is made.

The checked conditional Borel inference from supplied ROOT201 is as follows. For decreasing u_i,v_i and fixed j,width epsilon, a fixed continuous ramp can be positive only where u_j-v_j>epsilon. If i>=j and the later winner is incorrect, u_i<=v_i<=v_j, then u_j-u_i>epsilon. A uniform bound on the integral of the fixed majorant error u_j-u against every bounded-cost output controls the two offending measures before taking any weak limit. The fixed continuous ramp test then passes weakly; next the j limit passes in L1 at the now fixed measures; last an ordinary width sequence gives the strict Borel indicator by dominated convergence. This conditional ordering is sound. It assumes the genuine output, bounded-max identification, and uniform ordered errors. None is established by the inference itself.

Remaining original obligations are precise: (i) the full scalar section energy, weak usc and decreasing continuity, raw constant law and quadratic contraction; (ii) all finite shared moving trace and rational-barycenter raw compatibilities; (iii) a target-independent original-carrier genuine mixed operator, both continuous derivative signs and every bounded/unbounded approximation identity; (iv) all simultaneously changing physical and relative weighted limits and independence with degrees, costs, collars and time-deficient tails in justified order, without asserting E1 membership of physical horizontal-pole stages; (v) every genuine relative E1 output integrability, so the conditional negligible nullness of n2 applies; (vi) all antecedents of the supplied absolute midpoint, supporting-plane, no-jump, attainment and divisorial separation arguments, then every intrinsic-target existence and every-solution uniqueness; (vii) the inputs of strict Borel locality and genuine comparison; and (viii) any additional nonzero zero-volume range with an explicit replacement datum. The numerical-zero endpoint and diagnostic of n4 do not solve (viii) generally. The finite recipe n3 does not solve (ii)--(iv).

Deliverables are the standalone paper.tex/paper.pdf, gaps.md, result.json, source-ledger.json, the exact input.json and frozen/ copies, all 18 supplied whole units and their literal LF coordinates in supplied/index.json, independently acquired primary responses and complete mapped proof units in sources/, and the rerun programs with inputs, commands, outputs, tool versions and artifact-manifest.json. Run python3 rerun.py. The finite check reports 637 exact monomials in dimensions 1--6, raw mass coefficients 1, and interpolation prediction 33/32 versus true volume 1. Two successful pdfLaTeX passes are document evidence only. These are unverified drafts; execution success is not proof certification.

Historical ledger paths, other campaigns, active private outputs and historical verdicts were not opened. No agents were launched.
